scope: header_ecc.py lines45-216 read; exact original entry_assemble AST body run in isolation with standard zip/range compatibility aliases. No ECC codec/backend or whole module executed.

findings.detail: entry_assemble zips message-block offsets and ECC-block offsets, stopping at shorter iterable. Empty track produces no blocks, one-block track silently leaves second message block unrepresented. Reproduced without modifying original function.
ecc_correct_intra reuses the same assembler and starts fcorrected true. Missing/short metadata ECC can omit source field bytes before correction accounting; caller impact needs further qualification.

Header entry_fields also uses unchecked delimiter find results and lstrip byte-set semantics; raw-entry input avoids adaptive parser unbounded file read but malformed field handling remains permissive.
Only configured header is read by entry_assemble when fileheader absent. Successful header verification cannot establish whole-file exact equality or preservation of tail.
